title: Fate of the Gods
start: Talk to Azzanadra at the World Gate, just north-west of the entrance to Arandar, south of the Eagles' Peak lodestone.

recommended.t: A face mask or any item that acts as one, such as masked earmuffs or a Slayer helmet (not on slayer helmet stand)
Switch to the Ancient Magicks spell book and Ancient Curses prayer book before the quest
Restore potions or overloads for dealing with nihils' stat-reducing magic
Traveller's necklace, or activated Eagles' Peak lodestone to get to the World Gate
The fully charged engrammeter (if Mahjarrat Memories (miniquest) is completed)
8 backpack spaces for collecting the memoriam crystals in the opening area of Freneskae

kills.t: Multiple bladed, force, and throwing muspahs (level 150)

rewards.t: The Shard of Zaros, which when equipped grants protection from all factions in the God Wars Dungeon
Access to Freneskae via the World Gate
The ability to fight bladed, force, and throwing muspah in the Cradle
The ability to fight blood, shadow, ice, and smoke nihil in the Pit
Access to the Elder Halls, with a level 75 Divination training spot
The ability to collect elder energy and to create portents of degradation, signs of death, and portents of death, as well as elder charm summoning pouches
Access to rune dragons (requires completion of the quest Ritual of the Mahjarrat also)

steps.t: Optional: Equip a ring of visibility to skip some dialogue.
Find the World Gate, south of the Eagles' Peak lodestone.
Talk to Azzanadra. [Chat: Accept › 2 I'll help if I can. › Any › 4 Okay, let's hear your proposal. › Any › Any]
p: The glow showing when you switch to the correct symbol

steps.t: Rotate the right controls near the gate until you reach .
Rotate left until you reach .
Rotate right until you reach .
Step away from the controls, and speak to Sliske.
Put on a face mask or equivalent protection to avoid taking 50 damage every 15 seconds while in Freneskae.

If you have completed Mahjarrat Memories (miniquest), you should also bring the fully charged engrammeter. Operating the engrammeter on Freneskae will cause it to become a distorted engrammeter, which provides a 15% reduction to lightning damage on Freneskae and a one-time reward of 25,000 Divination experience.
Enter the World Gate to enter Freneskae.
Run through Freneskae using the map below to reach the Sanctum. Move fast and avoid the hazards. There are healing points along the way if needed.
Optional: collect the memoriam crystals along the way. They are numbered on the map below; for efficiency, start with collecting number 9, then 2, 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.
p: Map of Freneskae. Some red one-way indicators are inaccurate.

steps.t: Optional: Deposit collected Memoriam crystals in the middle to see memories.
p: The solution to the final puzzle.

steps.t: Go to the north side of the room to the door puzzle.
Match the symbols up together to light up the lines in between them three times to open the door, then enter.

Kill the four nihils then enter the next area to the north. All nihils use a special attack after hissing. Each nihil always runs in the same direction. Therefore, a pair of nihil (ice and shadow or smoke and blood) can be killed first, leaving areas between the tracks unused and safe. Don't stand in the middle, as you might be dashed by multiple nihils at once.

sub.t: Killing the nihils while all 4 are attacking you will unlock the title and the achievement Annihilator.
The smoke nihil attacks with Magic. Its special attack will decrease Attack, Strength, Magic, Ranged, and Defence by 15. Its charge will decrease these stats by 5.

The shadow nihil attacks with Ranged, and its special attack creates Nex-like shadow bomb at the position of player that deals rapid damage. Players should move away as soon as the floor below them is darkened by a circular spot. Shadow nihil darkens the whole screen whenever it approaches the player, both when charging or fighting the player, but this causes no gameplay difference.

The blood nihil attacks with melee. Its special attack causes all incoming damage to heal it, indicated when the creature lowers its head and begin to glow. It also will passively heal other nihil if it is damaged. Its charge inflicts a bleed similar to Slaughter that begins at 100 damage.

The ice nihil attacks with Magic, and its special attack applies a six second stun and drains player's Prayer points by 50% of its maximum. Its charge drains the player's Prayer points by 25% of its maximum.

p: The player arrives in the harsh realm of Freneskae

steps.t: Attempt to descend the ledge to the north then speak to Zaros. [Chat: Any › 5 I've heard all I need to. › 2 No, just tell me the crucial info. › 2 Yes, allow him in for now.]

sub.t: If you accept Zaros' help against Mah, he will provide you with full prayer for use with Ancient Curses along the fight and less damage from Mah.

steps.t: Defend against monsters while Mah has her nightmare (progress displayed at the top of the screen).

sub.t: Use Freedom or Anticipate after Mah clenches her hands to avoid being stunned when she screams in agony (though you will still take damage).

p: A player faces Mah's wrath as they fight the muspah.

steps.t: When the progress is 0%, climb down the ledge next to Mah's hand.
p: Zaros speaks to the player within their mind threshold
Using the Measure to harvest Mah's memories

steps.t: Collect The Measure and place it on the ground near faint wisps to activate them for harvesting (wisps can be found on the centre and edges of the cave. After revealing one, it will be a yellow dot on minimap).

Convert Mah memories into Mah Energy using the Energy rift. When you gather 250 energy, weave it into a simulacrum (dark to help Zaros, light to hinder Zaros). Hop worlds if you are having trouble finding wisps. You will be outside of the World Gate, enter again using the checkpoint option.
Return and speak to Zaros by exiting the rock face on the wall between two hallways (west of the energy rift). Speak to Zaros again after the cutscene. [Chat: Any]
p: Zaros shapes the Divine Simulacrum in his image
Zaros continues to form his new body
Zaros garbs his new body with robes and armour
Mah awakens and Zaros teleports you away
The wound in Zaros's chest if you give him a light simulacrum

steps.t: Talk to Azzanadra through the world gate. [Chat: 1 I'm ready. › Any]
Quest complete!

p: Zaros meets with his followers and excommunicates Sliske
